name: Dragon's Orb
desc: The activation and effects of Dragon monster effects activated on your field cannot be negated this turn. If you control a Dragon monster that is a Normal Monster or whose effects are negated: You can banish this card from your GY; add 2 Dragon monsters from your Deck to your hand with the same ATK/DEF as each other, but different names. You can only use this effect of "Dragon's Orb" once per turn.
